name: Ahuizotl
desc: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.
motives: Ambush, drown, restrain

features.name: Aquatic Attacker
features.desc: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Tail Swat
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

features.name: Drag and Bag
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily Restrain them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets Restrained in this way.

name: Archmage
desc: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.
motives: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Orbiting Aegis
features.desc:
When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6.
If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

features.name: Force Salvo
features.desc: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

features.name: Fireball
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

features.name: Counterspell
features.desc: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

name: Atototl
desc: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.
motives: Avoid, escape, misdirect

features.name: Wind Lord
features.desc: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

features.name: Stone of Omens
features.desc:
Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.
[[/fr]]

features.name: Archer's Bane
features.desc: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

name: Banshee
desc: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.
motives: Ambush from inside solid objects, frighten to death, mourn life and beauty lost, scream balefully

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

name: Basilisk
desc: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.
motives: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait

features.name: Petrify
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff . If the target is already Stiff , they become Petrified. While Stiff , the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

features.name: CRONCH!
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

name: Berserker Alpha
desc: A veteran commander who quaff s magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.
motives: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Berserker Initiate
desc: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.
motives: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Bugboar
desc: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.
motives: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

features.name: Surprise!
features.desc: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d8 damage.

features.name: Brutal
features.desc: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to deal an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Warheart
features.desc: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can spend a Fear to negate it.

name: Catrin
desc: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.
motives: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything

features.name: Attracted to Wealth
features.desc: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

features.name: The Weight of Opulence
features.desc: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

features.name: Expensive Failure
features.desc: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

name: Centaur Warden
desc: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motives: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

features.name: Trample
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Quick Volley
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

name: Cephilith Abomination
desc: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.
motives: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab

features.name: Toxic Skin
features.desc: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

features.name: Bear Hug
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

features.name: Crunch!
features.desc: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

features.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
features.desc: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

name: Cephilith Hatchling
desc: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.
motives: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Comatize
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Cephilith Novitiate
desc: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.
motives: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Sacrifice Self
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

name: Cephilith Titan
desc: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.
motives: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Merely a Projection
features.desc: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating its true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Psychic Scream
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Summon Worshippers
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

features.name: "It's Here…"
features.desc: When the Titan has marked half its HP, they manifests in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the "Merely a Projection" feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan's standard attack must mark an additional HP.

name: Chicken-foot Hut
desc: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.
motives: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

features.name: Fast
features.desc: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.desc: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

name: Cipactli
desc: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.
motives: Consume, reshape the land, trample

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Many Mouths
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Frenzied Feeding
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

features.name: Quaking Footfalls
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lifeblooded
features.desc: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Verdant Explosion
features.desc: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

name: Cloud Titan
desc: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.
motives: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

features.name: Mist Weaver
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

features.name: Nebulous Transformation
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

features.name: Unleash the Menagerie
features.desc: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

features.name: Wind Worker
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.desc: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don't gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

name: Common Ruffian
desc: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.
motives: Do violence, seek security and survival

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1d8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.desc: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

name: Crimson Lepus
desc: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.
motives: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: "Awww..."
features.desc: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Evasive
features.desc: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

features.name: "Run Away!"
features.desc: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

name: Cryptimoth
desc: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.
motives: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Psychic Screech
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Shadow Swarm
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

features.name: Paranoia Glare
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Insight Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

name: Cursed Merfolk
desc: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.
motives: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage

features.name: Fish-Tailed
features.desc: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

features.name: Gang Up
features.desc: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

features.name: "Get Over Here!"
features.desc: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

name: Darkweave Crawler
desc: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.
motives: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

features.name: Minion (3)
features.desc: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Skin-Crawling
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Darkweave Venom
features.desc: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

name: Darkweave Queen
desc: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.
motives: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Den Mother
features.desc: Once per scene, spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Quicker Than She Looks
features.desc: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

features.name: Darkfang Envenomation
features.desc: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

name: Darkweave Spinner
desc: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.
motives: Bite, stick to the darkness

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.desc: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings
desc: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.
motives: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

features.name: Horde (1d4)
features.desc: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 physical damage instead.

features.name: "Get 'em Off , Get 'em Off !"
features.desc: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a d6 when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

name: Deep Dweller
desc: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.
motives: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Brain Drain
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Call of the Deep
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Mucosal Contamination
features.desc: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

name: Demon Lord Berzug
desc: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent's tail, a lizard's hind legs, a crab's claw arms, and a two-faced wolf's head.
motives: Destroy goodness, sow chaos, unseat rivals

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Chaos Lash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Gaze into the Abyss
features.desc:
Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result):
1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.
3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll.
5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

features.name: Crushing Strike
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from Berzug's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You gain a Fear.

features.name: Horrifying
features.desc: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

name: Dire Pangolati
desc: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.
motives: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

features.name: Armor Eater
features.desc: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals 2d6+10 physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.desc: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

name: Doppelhound
desc: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.
motives: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive

features.name: Blink Beast
features.desc: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

name: Dragon Mother Mitera
desc: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.
motives: Birth destruction, control the battlefield, fly, repel invaders, use all available options

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Diamond Hide
features.desc: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. It ticks down from Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Elemental Breath
features.desc:
Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice:
Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP.
Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target.
Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP.
Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition.
Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it.
Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature.
Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.desc: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

features.name: Fearsome
features.desc: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Seven-Headed
features.desc: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the "Elemental Breath" option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see "Diamond Hide").

name: Drake
desc: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.
motives: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Guard Dog
features.desc: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

name: Dullahan
desc: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.
motives: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Spectral Mount
features.desc: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

features.name: Bone Whip Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Death Glare
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

name: Elephant
desc: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.
motives: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize

features.name: Trample
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.desc: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

name: Elk
desc: A large deer.
motives: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

features.name: Headbutt
features.desc: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals 1d12+2 physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.desc: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

name: Entombed Cat Beast
desc: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.
motives: Rush attack, shred, terrify

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Entombed Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.desc: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.desc: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.desc: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

name: Entombed Elite Guard
desc: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.
motives: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one

features.name: Battle Formation
features.desc: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

name: Entombed Empress
desc: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.
motives: Command inferiors, curse the invaders

features.name: Empty Husk
features.desc: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.desc: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.desc: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

name: Entombed Necropriest
desc: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.
motives: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon

features.name: Invigorate
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and Restrain them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target Restrained in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark 1d4 Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

name: Entombed Skin Beetles
desc: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.
motives: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.desc: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Omophagous
features.desc: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Entombed Stonemason
desc: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.
motives: Never stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.desc: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

name: Falcon
desc: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.
motives: Circle, clutch, dive, spy

features.name: Nimble Flyer
features.desc: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

features.name: Dive Bomb
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Fire Titan
desc: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.
motives: Act valorously, make war, think tactically

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Masterwork Armor
features.desc: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hurl Rock
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

features.name: Skull Splitter
features.desc: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

features.name: Blazing Heart
features.desc: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

name: Fire Titan Warlord
desc: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.
motives: Compete against rivals, conquer the weak, craft colossal war machines

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Colossus Crafter
features.desc: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Release the Hounds
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Spinning Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and gain a Fear.

features.name: Ground-Breaking
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

name: Flock Of Feather Fiends
desc: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.
motives: Caw incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes

features.name: Horde (1d6+1)
features.desc: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

name: Fowlbear
desc: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.
motives: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become Vulnerable until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

name: Frost Titan
desc: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.
motives: Claim trophies, raid and pillage, test mettle

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: War Horn
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

features.name: Cleaving Strike
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Trophy Hunter
features.desc: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

name: Fungispunj Sporeling
desc: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puff s of neurotoxic spores.
motives: Avoid violence, spray attackers

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.desc: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

name: Fungispunj Sporophore
desc: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.
motives: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.desc: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle
desc: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.
motives: Acquire riches, capsize trading vessels, lie in wait, use the waves as cover

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Piercing Bite
features.desc: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

features.name: Tail Bash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

features.name: Gigaton Splash
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Steam Breath
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

name: Gargantuan War Machine
desc: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.
motives: Crush, destroy

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Awesome Size
features.desc: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Rocket Punch
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

features.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Supercharged
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine's chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

name: Ghastly Legion
desc: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.
motives: Overwhelm, serve, swarm

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

features.name: Necroplasmic
features.desc: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

features.name: Final Act
features.desc: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

name: Giant Octopus
desc: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motives: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.desc: When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.desc: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to deal 3d8 direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

name: Griffin
desc: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.
motives: Hunt, look for an opening, swoop

features.name: Treasure Hoarder
features.desc: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin's attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

features.name: Swooping Slash
features.desc: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

name: Grimmling Warband
desc: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.
motives: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Cowardly
features.desc: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

name: Guahalan Alebrujo
desc: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.
motives: Destroy, give no quarter, ravage

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.desc: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can mark a Stress to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.desc: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

name: Guahalan Fang Lord
desc: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.
motives: Bolster allies, lead the pack, rally the troops

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.desc: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

name: Guahalan Shifter
desc: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.
motives: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
desc: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.
motives: Protect, sacrifice, surround

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.desc: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.desc: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
desc: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.
motives: Abjure, bolster, summon

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer summon 2d4 Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.desc: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can spend a Fear to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

name: Harbinger Of Death
desc: A desiccated corpse riding atop a skeletal horse. Their eyes are sewn shut and their body is wrapped in a burial shroud of dust and ash.
motives: Bring judgment, cut them down, move swiftly, seek relentlessly, take souls

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Fear the Reaper
features.desc: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Decapitate
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a death move.

features.name: Wake the Fallen
features.desc: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.desc: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

name: Harbinger Of Famine
desc: A dried-out husk of a body riding atop a withered white horse. They are covered in mouths and surrounded by swarming flies.
motives: Drain, impoverish, weaken, wither

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Hunger Pangs
features.desc: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can't spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Drain Essence
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

features.name: Too Many Mouths
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Withering Touch
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

name: Harbinger Of Pestilence
desc: A bloated and rotting agglomeration of wriggling insects and slugs formed into a single humanoid mass riding a worm-eaten horse.
motives: Corrupt the pure, infect the weak, summon plague and disease

features.name: Halo of Contagion
features.desc: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rolls until they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaffected by the condition.

features.name: Locust Swarm
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–2, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Frog Spawn
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Plague Bringer
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

name: Harbinger Of War
desc: A warrior clad in black armor and a horned helmet and bearing a bloody banner.
motives: Destroy utterly, fight honorably, relish combat, shield-bash, strike powerfully

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Iron Dice
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

features.name: Supreme Commander
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.desc: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

name: Harpy
desc: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.
motives: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

features.name: Toxic Aura
features.desc: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Swooping Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals 3d6 physical damage.

name: Hill Titan
desc: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.
motives: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Gullible
features.desc: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.desc: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Hive Walker
desc: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.
motives: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive

features.name: Blood Honey
features.desc: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.desc: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

name: Jack-o'-lantern
desc: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.
motives: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Jack-o'-lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

name: Kelpie
desc: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
motives: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

features.name: Captivating
features.desc: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.

features.name: Heart's Desire
features.desc: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Shapeshifter
features.desc: Mark a Stress to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Enchant
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

name: Lamia
desc: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
motives: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

features.name: Constriction
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4-1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.desc: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

name: Landshark
desc: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.
motives: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey

features.name: Burrowing
features.desc: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.desc: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.desc: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Landshark Behemoth
desc: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.
motives: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.desc: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.desc: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.desc: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

name: Manticore
desc: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.
motives: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.desc: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.desc: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.desc: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

name: Masque Muerte
desc: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.
motives: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

features.name: Libre
features.desc: The Masque Muerte can't be Restrained.

features.name: Heel Turn
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

features.name: Spectral Suplex
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

features.name: Unmasking Death
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Tag Team
features.desc: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

name: Mechanorb
desc: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.
motives: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

features.name: Hive Mind
features.desc: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics
features.desc: Pool. When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

name: Night Children
desc: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
motives: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

features.name: Horde (2d6+2)
features.desc: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swell Ranks
features.desc: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: Octopus
desc: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motives: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape

features.name: Grapple
features.desc: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Squirt Ink
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming Vulnerable until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

name: Pain Priest
