desc: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suff ering and ecstasy.
motives: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

features.name: Walk Between Worlds
features.desc: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Pleasure and Pain
features.desc: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

name: Panther
desc: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.
motives: Climb trees, pounce, stalk

features.name: Shadow Stalker
features.desc: While Hidden, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

name: Phantom
desc: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.
motives: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

features.name: Incorporeal
features.desc: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.desc: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

features.name: Lingering Haunt
features.desc: Countdown (1d6). When the Phantom is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

name: Phoenix
desc: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
motives: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

features.name: Purifying Aura
features.desc: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Fireseed
features.desc: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

features.name: Resurrection
features.desc: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

name: Plesiosaurus
desc: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
motives: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.desc: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

name: Poltergeist
desc: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.
motives: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Possessor
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

features.name: Ghost Storm
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d12+2 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Ravenous Mockery
desc: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.
motives: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.desc: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.desc: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

name: Redcap Biters
desc: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.
motives: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ankle Weights
features.desc: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

name: Redcap Breaker
desc: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motives: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

features.name: Backbreaker
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

features.name: Kneecapper
features.desc: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

name: Redcap Skinner
desc: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motives: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shallow Cuts
features.desc: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Roc
desc: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
motives: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.desc: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.desc: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

features.name: Nest Warden
features.desc:
When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:
Wrathful - Passive: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.
Electrifying Aura - Passive: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Wrathfull
features.desc: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

features.name: Electrifying Aura
features.desc: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

name: Ruby Dragon
desc: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.
motives: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Fearsome
features.desc: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Melting Breath
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Volcanic Fissure
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

features.name: Hot-Blooded
features.desc: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

name: Rugaru
desc: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.
motives: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Child of Night
features.desc: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodthirsty
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

features.name: Howl at the Moon
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Flesh Ripper
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.

name: Rust Eater
desc: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.
motives: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal

features.name: Stifling Pheromones
features.desc: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Rust Touch
features.desc: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

name: Sandwyrm
desc: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
motives: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.desc: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast
desc: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.
motives: Clamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline

features.name: Ka-Chomp
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 1d12 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Feeding Frenzy
features.desc: When a creature marks HP, you can spend a Fear to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

features.name: Scaly
features.desc: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

name: Scarecrow
desc: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.
motives: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw

features.name: Made of Straw
features.desc: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: Severed Shadow
desc: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.
motives: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shadow Grapple
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend
desc: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.
motives: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonate
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.desc: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed
desc: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.
motives: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Fiendish Resistance
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Demonic Rage
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Hall of Mirrors
features.desc: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Flash Claw
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

features.name: Mind Games
features.desc: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

name: Soul-shattered Mage
desc: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.
motives: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Broken Magic
features.desc:
Mark a Stress to roll a d6. The Mage uses the corresponding move:
1–2: Dimension Rift. Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes 2d6 direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.
3–4: Time Dilation. Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is Slowed until they roll with Hope. While Slowed, a target is Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they move.
5–6: Discordant Visions. Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take 2d8 direct magic damage.

features.name: Feel My Pain
features.desc: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

name: Spellbound Armor
desc: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.
motives: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently

features.name: Tireless
features.desc: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

features.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
features.desc: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

name: Sprite
desc: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motives: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Art of Invisibility
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

features.name: Dream Petal Poison
features.desc: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

name: Stone Titan
desc: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.
motives: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Skillful Strike
features.desc: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can mark a Stress and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Sunlight Sickness
features.desc: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Hammer Smash
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Storm Titan
desc: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.
motives: Erupt violently, wait, watch

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.desc: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix
desc: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.
motives: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.desc: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Elemental Archon
features.desc:
Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect:
Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam's path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage.
Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated.
Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets.
Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape.

features.name: Alpha to Omega
features.desc: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way.

features.name: Forsaken
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

features.name: Armageddon
features.desc: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a death move.

name: Temporal Enforcer
desc: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.
motives: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Time Looper
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

features.name: Move Between Moments
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

features.name: Instant Rewind
features.desc: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

features.name: Invert Polarity
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can't be used to alter a critical success.

name: Triceratops
desc: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.
motives: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.desc: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

name: Tyrannosaurus
desc: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.
motives: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.desc: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

name: Unicorn
desc: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.
motives: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent

features.name: Celestial Lance
features.desc: The Unicorn's standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.desc: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally's HP.

features.name: Protective Aura
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

name: Urco
desc: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.
motives: Feed, frighten, hunt

features.name: Fearmonger
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Terror-Fueled
features.desc: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Fear Eater
features.desc: Spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of HP.

features.name: Baleful Gaze
features.desc: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can spend a Fear to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

name: Valdenhax
desc: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.
motives: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers

features.name: To Me, My Pretties
features.desc: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

features.name: Shadow Strangler
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

features.name: Corpse Whisperer
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

features.name: Vexing Word
features.desc: After a PC makes a roll, you can mark a Stress to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

name: Vampire Bat Swarm
desc: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.
motives: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease

features.name: Horde (2d6)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.desc: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsuckers
features.desc: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

name: Vampire Lord
desc: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.
motives: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Midnight Heart
features.desc: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it's destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Unleash Hellfire
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Resurgence
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Melt into Shadow
features.desc: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

features.name: Hellwing
features.desc: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature.

features.name: On Crimson Wings
features.desc: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Blood Bath
features.desc: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

name: Viper
desc: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.
motives: Lie in wait, slither, strike

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous
features.desc: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Viscera Sucker
desc: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.
motives: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Join or Die
features.desc: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

name: Water Mother
desc: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.
motives: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water

features.name: Segmented
features.desc: The Water Mother's body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

features.name: Eat the World
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

features.name: Constrict
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

features.name: Venom Surge
features.desc: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

name: Waxwork Creation
desc: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.
motives: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: No Vital Organs
features.desc: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

features.name: Wax Ball
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Splutch!
features.desc: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Smothering Grapple
features.desc: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation's wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

name: Will-o'-the-wisps
desc: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.
motives: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray

features.name: Horde (1d4-1)
features.desc: When the Will-o'-the-wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4-1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Kaleidoscopic
features.desc: The Will-o'-the-wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-wisps are Vulnerable.

features.name: Fascinating
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Will-o'-the-wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-wisps.

name: Wyrmfiend
desc: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.
motives: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.desc: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous Bite
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Wyrmlings
desc: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.
motives: Consume, shred, swarm

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ravenous
features.desc: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

name: Wyvern
desc: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.
motives: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.desc: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Xero The Castle Killer
desc: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.
motives: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.desc: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Collateral Damage
features.desc: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Gigaton Stomp
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

features.name: Power Slide
features.desc: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

features.name: Radioactive Breath
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

features.name: Regeneration
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

name: Young Fire Dragon
desc: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.
motives: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.desc: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

features.name: Flame Breath
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Blazing Scales
features.desc: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.desc: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

name: Yufo
desc: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.
motives: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows

features.name: Telepathic
features.desc: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

features.name: Psychic Strongbox
features.desc: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

features.name: Glitch Wave
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

features.name: Temporal Corrosion
features.desc: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.
